prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: production transparent raster sprite atlas of six blank Gondor button plates for a real Middle-earth dashboard, not a page mockup.
Primary request: create exactly SIX finely crafted physical button plates in an EXACT 3-column by 2-row aligned grid. Canvas 1536 by 1024, each cell 512 by 512. One horizontal rectangular plate centered inside each cell; the plates all have the SAME outer geometry and footprint, about 440px wide and 120px high, with generous transparent separation. Nothing may cross a cell boundary. All six plates seen directly from the front, no perspective, no diagonal rotation.
Visual identity: the royal court of Gondor at twilight, silver masonry and dark steel, midnight navy. Match pale worn silver corner armor, subtle eight-point star engravings at extreme corners, thin hand-finished silver rails, charcoal steel underlayer, and dark navy leather center. A very small architectural filigree accent at the left and right edges only. The center two-thirds must be calm flat dark navy material with enough contrast for cream HTML text, completely empty. Restrained elegance, dimensional lighting and tactile materials, not generic flat CSS gradients.
State order is IMPORTANT, left to right: top row NORMAL, HOVER, PRESSED; bottom row SECONDARY, SECONDARY HOVER, DISABLED. Do NOT render these state names or ANY lettering.
Top normal: crisp pale silver border, midnight navy leather inset. Hover: slightly brighter silver edge and a restrained cool blue highlight, same shape. Pressed: subtly inset darker steel and darker navy center, same shape. Secondary: quieter satin silver and less bright navy. Secondary hover: slightly brighter satin silver and soft cool sheen. Disabled: subdued gray steel with muted desaturated navy, still clearly constructed, no slashes or symbols.
Border proportions: narrow rails and small deliberate corner details, approximately 8–12px rails at the stated source footprint. Slightly chamfered or softly rounded rectangular corners, not ornate leaf swirls. No giant crests, no centered White Tree, no gems covering text area, no banners protruding above/below, no golden trim, no Hobbit wood or foliage.
Transparent background: actual alpha channel, no checkerboard painted in, no white or gray backdrop. Outside the six plates must be fully transparent. Keep their interiors opaque so these can serve as accessible button backgrounds. No text, labels, runes, numbers, icons, watermark, or UI controls within the plates. Six isolated consistent silhouettes only.
